name: NexGen Energy Ltd.
blurb: NexGen Energy Ltd. is a Canadian uranium exploration and development company focused on its flagship Rook I Project in the Athabasca Basin of Saskatchewan, Canada, which hosts the Arrow deposit — one of the largest and highest-grade uranium discoveries in the world. The company is advancing Arrow toward production as a potential low-cost, large-scale uranium mine designed to supply nuclear fuel for clean energy generation. NexGen is also listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) under the same ticker and is considered a leading pure-play uranium development name globally.
recent: NexGen's stock hit a 52-week high of $13.96 on January 28, 2026, reflecting strong investor interest in uranium amid growing nuclear energy demand. As of mid-May 2026, shares trade around $12.18–$12.19, near the upper end of their 52-week range of $5.29–$13.96. CNBC noted in March 2026 that options strategies targeting nuclear energy stocks including NXE gained attention in the context of a broader shift toward nuclear power driven by geopolitical developments in the Middle East.
